article_notes: Indian veterinary college clinic: 24 PCR-positive B. gibsoni dogs; 9 met Mathe et al. 2006 criteria for clinical syndromes (hepatopathy, ARF, pancreatitis, ARDS). The syndromes are defined by the same biochemical markers that are reported, and no marker is compared between dogs with and without syndromes (only whole-group means, Table 2, and individual values of affected dogs). Breed distribution (Table 3) is given only for the 9 affected dogs. Nothing extractable against severity; the claimed breed predisposition rests on counts among affected dogs only.

not_extracted.what: Breed vs presence of clinical syndromes (German Shepherds 4/9 of affected dogs)
not_extracted.note: Breeds of the 15 dogs without syndromes are not given.
